description: List procedure references by procedure type. Titles, stages, and participants require euparl_get_procedure with a returned procedure_id. Use euparl_list_reference topic procedure_types for supported process_type codes. No keyword, year, committee, or stage filter is available. With process_type, every procedure of that type is listed in procedure_id order: continue with page.next_offset, passing the returned page.snapshot to detect a changed set. Without process_type, at most 10000 results are reachable and Parliament serves pages from two orderings, so pages can repeat or omit procedures; continue with page.next_offset when present, and set process_type for a complete walk.

language.description: Supported EU ISO-639-1 language, case-insensitive; default en; source text is never translated.

limit.description: Whole items requested; default 20. Pages hold at most 300 procedures; a larger limit returns that many with a notice.

process_type.description: Optional procedure-type code from euparl_list_reference topic procedure_types; case-insensitive and whitespace-trimmed.

snapshot.description: Returned page.snapshot of a process_type listing; optional at every offset, and a set that changed since fails snapshot_changed. Rejected without process_type.

name: euparl_list_procedures

appliedFilters.description: Actual normalized retrieval scope and filters.

available.description: Whether the selected source array was published, including a published empty array.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A nonblank procedure type or language is unsupported, or offset is 10000 or more without process_type, past the 10000-result search window. `invalid_mode_fields`: snapshot is supplied without process_type. `snapshot_changed`: The complete process_type set changed since the supplied snapshot. `upstream_paging_stalled`: A process_type response holds fewer distinct procedures than its reported total, repeats a procedure, or reaches the 10000-result window. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects validated request parameters. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limits persist after bounded retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: Whole sparse procedure records on this page.

process_type.description: Published procedure type code or URI.

reference.description: Exact published procedure reference, not a title.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

has_more.description: Whether more matches are known or cannot be ruled out; a search window may prevent continuation.

limit.description: Effective whole-item page size: the requested limit, clamped to the collection's page cap and, on a 10000-result search, to the results left in the window.

next_offset.description: Usable next offset when continuation is accessible; absent at a search-window boundary even if has_more is true.

offset.description: Zero-based position in the selected collection.

returned.description: Number of complete items on this page.

snapshot.description: Digest of the complete normalized local collection and scope; reuse for continuation.

shown.description: Whole items shown on this partial page.

totalCount.description: Exact count only when published or computed over a complete collection.

truncated.description: True when this page returns only part of the selected collection.

title: List parliamentary procedures
